title: Everything changed when the fire crystal got stolen - Alex Gendler
speaker: TED-Ed
zh: 【TED-Ed】當火水晶被盜後一切都改變了 - Alex Gendler（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Someone has tripped the magical alarms in the Element Temple.
cues.en: Someone has tripped the magical alarms in the Element Temple.
cues.zh: 不速之客驚動了「四元壇」魔法鐘

cues.text: By the time you and the other monks arrive on the scene, you know you have a disaster on your hands.
cues.en: By the time you and the other monks arrive on the scene, you know you have a disaster on your hands.
cues.zh: 不速之客驚動了「四元壇」魔法鐘 你和一眾僧侶聞聲馳赴現場 就知道大事不妙

cues.text: Overnight, four young apprentices broke into the temple’s inner chamber
cues.en: Overnight, four young apprentices broke into the temple’s inner chamber
cues.zh: 四名年少門生漏夜闖進四元壇內殿

cues.text: to steal the sacred element crystals.
cues.en: to steal the sacred element crystals.
cues.zh: 四名年少門生漏夜闖進四元壇內殿 想偷走神聖的四元神石

cues.text: But when the alarm went off they panicked, and each of them swallowed the crystal they held right before they were caught.
cues.en: But when the alarm went off they panicked, and each of them swallowed the crystal they held right before they were caught.
cues.zh: 想偷走神聖的四元神石 鐘聲響起，門生東窗事發驚惶失措 情急之下各將手持的一枚神石吞下 四門生修煉畢竟未臻化境

cues.text: With no idea how to control the crystals’ vast powers,
cues.en: With no idea how to control the crystals’ vast powers,
cues.zh: 四門生修煉畢竟未臻化境 神靈很快就會附體，此事非同小可

cues.text: they’ll soon transform into uncontrollable elemental spirits.
cues.en: they’ll soon transform into uncontrollable elemental spirits.
cues.zh: 神靈很快就會附體，此事非同小可 雖然事出不意、非比尋常

cues.text: Improbably enough, the old monk next to you has seen something similar happen before.
cues.en: Improbably enough, the old monk next to you has seen something similar happen before.
cues.zh: 雖然事出不意、非比尋常 身旁老僧畢竟見多識廣神色自若說： 「你必先弄清各人體內神石為何

cues.text: He explains: “You must determine who ate which crystal
cues.en: He explains: “You must determine who ate which crystal
cues.zh: 「你必先弄清各人體內神石為何 趁為時未晚移到相剋的禪室閉關淨化

cues.text: and get each into the proper containment field before they transform.
cues.en: and get each into the proper containment field before they transform.
cues.zh: 趁為時未晚移到相剋的禪室閉關淨化

cues.text: The elements compel their masters: those who ate the Earth and Water Crystals must speak the truth,
cues.en: The elements compel their masters: those who ate the Earth and Water Crystals must speak the truth,
cues.zh: 趁為時未晚移到相剋的禪室閉關淨化 神石在體內會左右主人 吞下地靈、水靈神石的人必說真話

cues.text: while those who consumed Fire and Air must lie."
cues.en: while those who consumed Fire and Air must lie."
cues.zh: 吞下火靈、天靈神石的人必說謊話」

cues.text: The youths are too scared to confess their own transgressions.
cues.en: The youths are too scared to confess their own transgressions.
cues.zh: 吞下火靈、天靈神石的人必說謊話」 門生驚慌失措，不敢直認過失

cues.text: Instead, they fall to accusing each other.
cues.en: Instead, they fall to accusing each other.
cues.zh: 門生驚慌失措，不敢直認過失 犯下滔天大禍，卻互相推諉

cues.text: “Rikku took the Water crystal!” Sumi blurts out.
cues.en: “Rikku took the Water crystal!” Sumi blurts out.
cues.zh: 「柳寬奪走了水靈神石！」宣旼搶說

cues.text: Rikku interrupts angrily.
cues.en: Rikku interrupts angrily.
cues.zh: 柳寬怒嗆：

cues.text: “It was Bella, she stole the Fire crystal!” So Bella yells: “Jonah ate the Air crystal, I saw him!”
cues.en: “It was Bella, she stole the Fire crystal!” So Bella yells: “Jonah ate the Air crystal, I saw him!”
cues.zh: 「是白蘭，她偷走了火靈神石！」 白蘭就大喊： 「蔣昂吞下天靈神石，我看到的！」

cues.text: Jonah looks up timidly and shakes his head.
cues.en: Jonah looks up timidly and shakes his head.
cues.zh: 蔣昂虛怯地抬起頭，搖搖頭說：

cues.text: “I… I don’t know what happened, but Sumi doesn’t have the Earth crystal.”
cues.en: “I… I don’t know what happened, but Sumi doesn’t have the Earth crystal.”
cues.zh: 蔣昂虛怯地抬起頭，搖搖頭說： 「我……我也不知道 但宣旼沒有地靈神石」

cues.text: So who ate which crystal?
cues.en: So who ate which crystal?
cues.zh: 但宣旼沒有地靈神石」 究竟，是誰吞下哪枚神石？

cues.text: Pause now to figure it out for yourself.
cues.en: Pause now to figure it out for yourself.
cues.zh: 究竟，是誰吞下哪枚神石？ 跌跌碰碰反覆試驗似乎少不了

cues.text: There’s no getting around it— this will take some trial and error.
cues.en: There’s no getting around it— this will take some trial and error.
cues.zh: 跌跌碰碰反覆試驗似乎少不了 但這不是壞事

cues.text: But that’s not a bad thing.
cues.en: But that’s not a bad thing.
cues.zh: 但這不是壞事 若是猜錯的話，到了某一個點

cues.text: If we make a wrong guess, we’ll eventually reach a point where our conclusions contradict each other.
cues.en: If we make a wrong guess, we’ll eventually reach a point where our conclusions contradict each other.
cues.zh: 但這不是壞事 若是猜錯的話，到了某一個點 立論就會相與悖繆，無從立足

cues.text: That would allow us to confirm that our initial guess was wrong and work from there.
cues.en: That would allow us to confirm that our initial guess was wrong and work from there.
cues.zh: 立論就會相與悖繆，無從立足 屆時就確認了當初的猜想是錯的 回到原點

cues.text: This is a technique known as proof by contradiction.
cues.en: This is a technique known as proof by contradiction.
cues.zh: 回到原點 這種技巧叫做「反證法」

cues.text: The trick is in being strategic about where we begin our guessing.
cues.en: The trick is in being strategic about where we begin our guessing.
cues.zh: 這種技巧叫做「反證法」 秘訣是一開始的猜想要帶一點計謀

cues.text: Some assumptions might not lead to contradictions without making further assumptions.
cues.en: Some assumptions might not lead to contradictions without making further assumptions.
cues.zh: 秘訣是一開始的猜想要帶一點計謀 一些假設未必引起矛盾 要加上進一步假設，矛盾才會出現

cues.text: We want to pick one that creates the most constraints on its own,
cues.en: We want to pick one that creates the most constraints on its own,
cues.zh: 要挑個立竿見影、制限最多的假設 這樣孰對孰錯都能給我們最多資訊

cues.text: and thus gives us the most information when it turns out to be right or wrong.
cues.en: and thus gives us the most information when it turns out to be right or wrong.
cues.zh: 這樣孰對孰錯都能給我們最多資訊 比如說，宣旼的陳述

cues.text: Take, for example, Sumi’s statement.
cues.en: Take, for example, Sumi’s statement.
cues.zh: 比如說，宣旼的陳述 先假設她是說真話

cues.text: If we assume she’s telling the truth, we’d know the identity of both truth tellers.
cues.en: If we assume she’s telling the truth, we’d know the identity of both truth tellers.
cues.zh: 先假設她是說真話 據她所說，我們知道哪兩位說真話 柳寬有水靈神石

cues.text: Rikku would have the Water crystal, and since she’s not lying about him,
cues.en: Rikku would have the Water crystal, and since she’s not lying about him,
cues.zh: 柳寬有水靈神石 又因為她自己坦白揭發了柳寬 宣旼就有地靈神石

cues.text: Sumi would have Earth.
cues.en: Sumi would have Earth.
cues.zh: 宣旼就有地靈神石 然後柳寬坦承，白蘭有火靈神石

cues.text: So Bella would have the Fire crystal, as Rikku says.
cues.en: So Bella would have the Fire crystal, as Rikku says.
cues.zh: 然後柳寬坦承，白蘭有火靈神石 白蘭說蔣昂有天靈神石，就必屬謊話

cues.text: But then Bella would have to be lying about Jonah having the Air crystal.
cues.en: But then Bella would have to be lying about Jonah having the Air crystal.
cues.zh: 白蘭說蔣昂有天靈神石，就必屬謊話 那卻是擺在眼前的唯一選項

cues.text: And yet that’s the only remaining option.
cues.en: And yet that’s the only remaining option.
cues.zh: 那卻是擺在眼前的唯一選項 這就是矛盾，表示一開始假設有誤

cues.text: This is a contradiction, and it tells us our initial assumption was wrong.
cues.en: This is a contradiction, and it tells us our initial assumption was wrong.
cues.zh: 這就是矛盾，表示一開始假設有誤 我們就從頭再來

cues.text: So now we can go back to the start, but with the added knowledge that Sumi is lying.
cues.en: So now we can go back to the start, but with the added knowledge that Sumi is lying.
cues.zh: 我們就從頭再來 然而，現在知道宣旼是在說謊話 撒謊的宣旼必然有火靈或天靈神石

cues.text: As a liar, Sumi must either have the Fire or Air crystal.
cues.en: As a liar, Sumi must either have the Fire or Air crystal.
cues.zh: 然而，現在知道宣旼是在說謊話 撒謊的宣旼必然有火靈或天靈神石 這表示蔣昂關於她的說話是真話

cues.text: That means Jonah was telling the truth about her, so he can’t have taken either of those.
cues.en: That means Jonah was telling the truth about her, so he can’t have taken either of those.
cues.zh: 這表示蔣昂關於她的說話是真話 換言之，火靈或天靈神石都不在蔣昂 白蘭指控他的說話必然也是謊話

cues.text: And that means Bella was lying about him, so she must also have either Fire or Air.
cues.en: And that means Bella was lying about him, so she must also have either Fire or Air.
cues.zh: 換言之，火靈或天靈神石都不在蔣昂 白蘭指控他的說話必然也是謊話 故此她一樣要嘛有火靈，要嘛有天靈

cues.text: Since Sumi was lying, Rikku can’t have taken the Water crystal—
cues.en: Since Sumi was lying, Rikku can’t have taken the Water crystal—
cues.zh: 既然宣旼撒謊，柳寬沒可能奪走水靈

cues.text: the only one left who could have it is Jonah.
cues.en: the only one left who could have it is Jonah.
cues.zh: 既然宣旼撒謊，柳寬沒可能奪走水靈 唯一可能有水靈神石的，就是蔣昂 由於說謊話的兩位門生已經找到

cues.text: And because we’ve already identified the two liars, Rikku must have the Earth crystal.
cues.en: And because we’ve already identified the two liars, Rikku must have the Earth crystal.
cues.zh: 由於說謊話的兩位門生已經找到 柳寬有的一定是地靈神石

cues.text: That means Bella has the Fire crystal and Sumi has Air.
cues.en: That means Bella has the Fire crystal and Sumi has Air.
cues.zh: 柳寬有的一定是地靈神石 換言之，火靈在白蘭，地靈在宣旼

cues.text: You manage to get them all in the proper containment fields just as the crystals’ magic begins to manifest.
cues.en: You manage to get them all in the proper containment fields just as the crystals’ magic begins to manifest.
cues.zh: 換言之，火靈在白蘭，地靈在宣旼 神靈正要顯現之際 你剛好把門生都放在相剋禪室淨化 化險為夷

cues.text: Compared with the difficult task of training these kids to control their new powers,
cues.en: Compared with the difficult task of training these kids to control their new powers,
cues.zh: 化險為夷 比起要為這班少不更事的門生 讓他們修身養性，傳習新魔法武功

cues.text: figuring out who had which crystal was elementary.
cues.en: figuring out who had which crystal was elementary.
cues.zh: 將四元神石歸位簡直易如反掌
